entries.4a14a317b2bb8bfc: It has a structure in which the group handles everything from product development through manufacturing to sales in an integrated manner, and it divides the roles of sales and manufacturing between separate companies. Manufacturing is handled by the factories in Hyuga, Miyazaki Prefecture and the factory in Vietnam, and its main products include the artificial dialysis indwelling needle 'Happy Cath' and the intravenous indwelling needle 'Super Cath.' It develops and launches on the market products designed for safety so that medical staff can use them with confidence, such as indwelling needles with a needle-stick prevention mechanism.
